warn.title: Warning!
warn.desc:
USB installations may not work on all devices and setups.
If you experience issues, try using Quark wirelessly.

error.title: No USB connection detected
error.desc: Plug in to a compatible device to install over USB

hdd.title: No USB drive detected
hdd.notfound: Plug in a USB SSD or hard drive to install from it.

applet.title: Applet Mode not supported
applet.desc:
You may experience issues using Leaflet in Applet Mode. If you do
have problems, please switch to running Leaflet over an installed
title (hold R while starting a game)!

info.sd: Install NSP/NSZ/XCI/XCZ files stored on your SD card.
info.hdd: Install files directly from a connected USB SSD or hard drive.
info.gc: Install titles directly from an inserted gamecard.
info.usb: Install over USB or LAN using Quark.
info.exit: Close Leaflet and return to HOME.
info.browser: Browse the SD card and set the archive bit on folders containing split game files.
info.net: Install titles from a PC running Quark over the local network.

choose.title: Install via Quark
choose.desc: Choose how to connect to Quark on your PC.

help.title: Help
help.desc:
Copy your NSP, NSZ, XCI, or XCZ files to your SD card, browse to and
select the ones you want to install, then press the Plus button.

sd.top_info: Select what files you want to install, then press the Plus button!
sd.delete_info: installed! Delete it from the SD card?
sd.delete_info_multi: files installed successfully! Delete them from the SD card?
sd.delete_desc: The original files aren't needed anymore after they've been installed
sd.buttons:  Install File(s)     Select All     Archive Bit     Help     Cancel

help.title: Help
help.desc:
Plug in a USB SSD or hard drive, browse to and select NSP, NSZ, XCI,
or XCZ files, then press the Plus button.

hdd.top_info: Select what files you want to install, then press the Plus button!
hdd.delete_info: installed! Delete it from the USB drive?
hdd.delete_info_multi: files installed successfully! Delete them from the USB drive?
hdd.delete_desc: The original files aren't needed anymore after they've been installed
hdd.buttons:  Install File(s)     Select All     Archive Bit     Help     Cancel

help.title: Help
help.desc:
Your game dumps can be installed using Quark.
To use this feature, open Quark on your PC, configure a path (or multiple!)
for easy accessibility and select the game dumps you wish to install!

usb.top_info: USB connection successful! Waiting for list of files to be sent...
usb.top_info2: Select what files you want to install over USB, then press the Plus button!
usb.error: USB transfer timed out or failed

info_page.failed_desc: Partially installed contents can be removed from the System Settings applet.

archivebit.title: Archive bit set
archivebit.desc: The folder is now seen as a file and can be selected for installation.
archivebit.confirm_desc:
This will mark "{}" as a file.
This cannot be undone from within Leaflet.
archivebit.error_desc: Archive bit is only supported on the SD card.

browser.buttons:  Archive Bit     Copy     Paste     Delete     Help     Back

help.title: Help
help.desc:
Browse files and folders.
A: Open folder
B: Go up / back to drives / main menu
ZL: Set archive bit on selected folder
R: Copy selected item to clipboard
ZR: Paste clipboard item here
Y: Delete selected item
X: This help screen

copy.title: Copy to clipboard
copy.fat32_desc: "{}" is larger than 4 GB and cannot be copied to a FAT32 formatted drive. Reformat the drive as exFAT to copy files larger than 4 GB.

paste.error_same: Source and destination are the same.

net.no_drives: Quark reported no drives or special paths.

ip.title: Enter Quark PC IP
ip.desc:
Enter the IP address of the PC running Quark (e.g. 192.168.1.10).
Make sure Quark is running with network support enabled.
ip.select_desc: Select a saved host or enter a new one.
ip.name_desc: Enter a name for this host (e.g. "Home PC")
ip.save_desc: Save this host for future use?

connect_fail.title: Connection failed
connect_fail.desc: Could not connect to Quark. Make sure Quark is running on the PC with network support enabled, and the IP address is correct.

already_installed.title: Already installed
already_installed.same_version: This version is already installed. Reinstall it?
already_installed.diff_version: A different version of this title is already installed. Replace it?

install_dialog.title: Gamecard Install
install_dialog.no_content_desc: No gamecard is mounted or no installable content was found.

nothing_selected_dialog.title: Nothing selected
nothing_selected_dialog.desc: Select at least one content type to install.

update_not_selected.title: Update data not selected
update_not_selected.desc:
This gamecard includes update data that you have not selected.

Some titles require their update to be installed before launching.
You may see a "necessary data" prompt when starting the game.

Continue with base game only?

sigpatches.title: Signature patches not detected
sigpatches.desc:
Signature patches were not detected on this console.

Installing unofficial software without signature patches
may result in a non-functional installation.

Proceed anyway?

downgrade.title: Downgrade warning
downgrade.desc:
You are installing an older version over a newer one.

Downgrading can cause save data corruption or loss,
and may make the game unplayable.

Proceed with downgrade?

menu_items.ignore_firm: Ignore minimum firmware version required by titles
menu_items.ask_delete: Ask to delete original files after installation

update.title: Update available
update.desc1: is available now! Ready to update?
update.end_desc: The software will now be closed.
update.desc_check_fail: You are on the latest version of Leaflet!

language.desc: The software will be closed after changing languages. Press B to cancel.

Example: #8D00FFBF
The value was not applied.

set to {}.

The background gradient has been regenerated

Colors reset to Leaflet defaults
and applied immediately.
